name: Cybersecurity Engineer
description: From computer networking and Linux internals to penetration testing, threat modeling, SIEM monitoring, and defensive security operations.

levels.title: Networking & OS Security
levels.description: TCP/IP protocols, DNS, OSI model, packet analysis with Wireshark, and Linux server hardening.

topics.title: Wireshark & Traffic Capture
topics.description: Inspecting TCP handshakes, TLS negotiation, and identifying malicious payloads in PCAP files.

levels.title: Ethical Hacking & Web Security (OWASP)
levels.description: OWASP Top 10 (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF), Burp Suite, and vulnerability assessment.

topics.title: OWASP Top 10 Exploits & Mitigations
topics.description: Testing for and fixing SQL injection, XSS, broken access controls, and SSRF vulnerabilities.

levels.title: Defensive Security & SOC Operations
levels.description: SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic), incident response, firewall configuration, and endpoint detection.

topics.title: SIEM Monitoring & Incident Response
topics.description: Log correlation, writing detection rules, threat hunting, and containment playbooks.
